lede.purpose: Hero and closing sub-copy at ink 75%.

body.purpose: All running text, tabular figures, max 68ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase label above lists and nav groups; never above a headline.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest, secondary pill, primary button on hover.

shadows.name: lattice-shade
shadows.value: three.js ShadowMaterial color 0x0c5755 opacity 0.22, PCF soft, radius 3
shadows.purpose: The mashrabiya's pattern thrown onto the wall behind it.

motion.name: hero-in
motion.value: 1.1s expo-out; from opacity 0, translateY(48px), blur(14px); delays .04s/.2s/.32s

motion.name: ease-in-out-strong
motion.purpose: Line draws (2.2s) and the scroll cue (1.8s loop).

motion.name: scroll-smoothing
motion.value: p += (goal - p) * (1 - exp(-dt * 9)); settles in about 0.35s; idle redraw about 15fps
motion.purpose: Hero follows scroll at the same pace on slow and fast devices.

motion.name: beat-windows
motion.value: [0.13,0.38] [0.34,0.6] [0.62,1.01]; 6% fade in/out with 40px travel and 12px blur
motion.purpose: Scroll beats over the hero scene.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations .01ms; hero renders progress 0.95 still; beats become a static list

narrative.overview:
KinSight is a daylight world: a cool mint-grey canvas, white surfaces, night-teal ink, one deep teal accent, and warm sand as the light that comes through. Privacy is the architecture, and the mashrabiya (a lattice screen you can see out of without being seen) is its signature: eight-point stars of sand with teal light in the gaps. The app screens are quiet and dense with care information; the landing page is the one place the screen becomes a 3D object that opens as you scroll.

Tokens are CSS variables holding space-separated RGB triplets (app/globals.css), so light, dark and high-contrast share one set of class names; the frontmatter mirrors the light theme, the variables are normative. Every surface works in Arabic RTL with full parity, honours reduced motion, and never uses colour as the only signal. The tone is calm and neutral: information, not a verdict.
keyCharacteristics: One teal accent for action; indigo reserved for "found"; sand as warmth, never alarm.
Soft two-layer shadows tinted with the ink colour, never neutral black in light mode.
Generous radii (8px controls, 16px cards, full pills on the landing).
Expo-out motion that resolves to a complete still when motion is reduced.
Mashrabiya star lattice as the reusable signature motif, in 3D and as a faint SVG pattern.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only action colour. Every primary button, active toggle and focus ring is brand-600; nothing else competes for the eye.

rules.name: The Indigo Means Found Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only for the "found" state. Carrier status is never red or green; tiers are indigo, neutral grey-green and amber.

rules.name: The Three Themes Rule
rules.body: A new colour is a CSS variable with a light, dark and high-contrast value, consumed as `rgb(var(--x) / alpha)`; no hex in components outside the landing hero's lighting.

rules.name: The Display Is For Story Rule
rules.body: Bricolage and Reem Kufi set landing and persuasion headings only. App screens keep Plus Jakarta page titles.

rules.name: The Bare Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines stand alone: no label, kicker or eyebrow above them. The uppercase label names a list or nav group, never a heading.

rules.name: The Ink-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are two layers, a tight contact and a long negative-spread blur, always tinted with the ink token. No hard offsets, no coloured glows.

dos: Do express every colour as a CSS variable RGB triplet with light, dark and high-contrast values.
Do keep brand-600 the single action colour and indigo the single "found" colour.
Do tint shadows with the ink token using the Card and Lift recipes.
Do give every scroll-driven or animated piece a resolved still for reduced motion and a no-WebGL fallback.
Do mirror layout, gradients, icons and 3D camera offsets in RTL.
Do use the eight-point star lattice as the signature motif, at low opacity when it is decorative.
donts: Don't use red or green for carrier status.
Don't put a label, kicker or eyebrow above a headline.
Don't use the display faces on app screens; they belong to landing and persuasion headings.
Don't use hard offset or untinted black shadows in light mode.
Don't hard-code hex colours in components; the landing hero's lighting (three.js scene and stage gradient) is the only exception.
